entrada.titulo: Privacy-preserving vaccine supply chain management leveraging blockchain and self-sovereign identity

perfil_anterior.solucao: emerging technologies such as blockchain and Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) have gained attention for improving the efficiency, transparency, and security of vaccine supply chain management
perfil_anterior.avaliacao: empirical results prove the efficacy of the proposed supply chain framework
perfil_anterior.limites: identity-agnostic or centrally managed identity models
perfil_anterior.possibilidades:
• Integrar computação de borda para verificação em tempo real da autenticidade dos lotes nas fronteiras da cidade inteligente.
• Combinar SSI com criptografia baseada em atributos (ABE) para controle de acesso granular aos dados de rastreamento.
• Avaliar a interoperabilidade entre plataformas municipais de saúde e provedores de identidade descentralizada usando padrões de credenciais verificáveis.
• Implementar revogação distribuída de credenciais SSI via contratos inteligentes.
• Aplicar a arquitetura a sensores IoT de monitoramento de temperatura e localização na cadeia de frio das vacinas.

Furthermore, the integration of SSI enables selective disclosure 
and role-based authorization, allowing stakeholders to prove 
eligibility (e.g., certified manufacturer, authorized distributor, 
licensed healthcare provider) without revealing unnecessary identity 
attributes. This capability is absent in conventional blockchain-based 
vaccine traceability frameworks, which typically expose full 
participant identities or rely on static access control lists.
By combining SSI with blockchain, the proposed framework 
supports cross-border interoperability, revocable trust, and 
patient-centric privacy guarantees, making it particularly 
suitable for large-scale vaccination programs operating across 
heterogeneous regulatory environments. To the best of our 
knowledge, this work represents one of the few comprehensive 
efforts that systematically integrate SSI with blockchain to address 
both traceability and identity privacy in vaccine supply chain 
management.
1.1 Motivation
In recent years, the pharmaceutical industry has been struggling 
with the pervasive issue of drug counterfeiting, which poses 
significant risks to public health and safety. The emergence of 
counterfeit drugs in the supply chain undermines consumer trust, 
leads to severe health consequences, and results in substantial 
financial losses for manufacturers and governments. With the global 
trade in counterfeit medicines being a multi-billion-dollar industry, 
there is an urgent need for robust traceability mechanisms that 
ensure the authenticity and integrity of pharmaceutical products 
from production to the end consumer [14]. This study is motivated 
by the critical need to explore, evaluate, and enhance drug 
traceability systems to effectively combat the growing threat of

resposta.resumo: O trecho descreve como a integração de Self‑Sovereign Identity (SSI) ao blockchain elimina a vinculatividade de identidade e permite divulgação seletiva e autorização baseada em papéis, garantindo privacidade dos participantes e interoperabilidade transfronteiriça em cadeias de suprimentos de vacinas. Destaca ainda a necessidade de combater o contrabando de medicamentos e a escassez de soluções que conciliem rastreabilidade e privacidade.
